archetype: A mono-red Goblin go-wide deck whose commander copies a one-target spell once per other creature; storm is a second, thinner route. deck-audit establishes no archetype, so base targets apply. Two of the three declared targets are commander_gated false, so the deck has plans without Zada.
verdict: It functions: mana sources, colour sources and land count are at target, and taplands is the one mana axis over what an aggressive deck wants. What limits it is the board Zada multiplies, not the spells or the mana. Zada arrives at mean turn 4.076 onto 1.937 goldfish bodies at turn 4 and 2.478 at turn 5, and the goldfish kill lands by turn 8 in only 0.282 of games. Log 001 stalled on a keep with no cheap body; 002 was raced by a turn-five Krenko.

engine.declared: Bodies set the copy count: Zada copies a one-target cantrip or pump once per other creature. Storm (rituals plus Grapeshot, Empty the Warrens, Haze of Rage or Spreading Insurrection) is the second route.

components.reading: Cast by turn 6 in 0.944 of goldfish games, mean turn 4.076, partly off rituals cast into her. She arrives on time; what she arrives into is the problem.

The declared group is five cards, 0.672 overall and 0.539 by turn 6. The deck has 11 nonland body cards at mana value 2 or less: these five plus Goblin Bushwhacker, Goblin Lackey, Impulsive Pilferer, Conspicuous Snoop, Grenzo and Rundvelt Hordemaster. Eleven copies put one in an opening seven about 57% of the time, so over four openers in ten have none. Both logged games were in that group.

0.703 assembled, 0.552 by turn 6. Witch's Mark is a seventh verified ignition (with three Goblins it draws 8, discards 4, hand 2 -> 6, net +4 (stack 014)) and is not declared. Daring Discovery is not counted: its stack 015 failed the checker. Frontline Heroism adds one body per ignition cast: put Zada's trigger on the stack first so Frontline Heroism's resolves first; the Soldier then gets a copy, 6 cards against 5 the other way (stack 013).

The thinnest group. With four rituals the storm target reads 0.348, and 0.205 by turn 6; the ritual change did not move it, because the target counts cards drawn. It is the ceiling route, not the median one.

Same target as the payoff group. Ancestors' Aid (an untapped Treasure), Skirk Prospector and Storm-Kiln Artist also make mana mid-turn and are not declared. Great Train Heist is not one: its Treasure enters tapped. Mana Geyser's yield rests on an authored 0.5 tapped-land share.
One card protects the hub. Roaming Throne's ward protects only itself.

The token and storm targets are commander_gated false and survive without her, so this is a failure point for one route, not the deck.

cut_candidates.cost_of_cutting: One of two tutors, and the one that puts a Goblin (Krenko, Siege-Gang Commander) straight onto the battlefield every turn it survives. Tutor count halves.

open_questions.question: Widen the fodder target to all 11 cheap-body cards and re-measure, with and without Goblin Instigator and Hordeling Outburst; also run a keep rule requiring one of them.
open_questions.why_it_matters: The declared group of five is not the pilot's logged mulligan criterion, so the fodder adds are sized off a figure nobody has measured.

open_questions.question: Does spending a ritual on Zada before a body is down cost the storm turn its fuel? Answering it needs a goldfish model change first: the ritual loop always counts the uncast commander as a cost a ritual may reach (goldfish_turn.py:912-913), and no flag turns that off.
open_questions.why_it_matters: The current model casts Zada on turn 3 in 1068 of 10,000 games (mean turn 4.076), partly off rituals. Once a declared switch exists, re-run at the same seeds with and without it and compare the storm target and kill by turn 8; until then the trade is unpriced.

open_questions.question: Daring Discovery cast at Zada: how many discovers resolve, and does a discovered card that kills a later copy's target cut the count? Stack 015 is a saved FAIL.
open_questions.why_it_matters: If it passes it is an eighth ignition card; until then it is a five-mana sorcery the copy route cannot count on.

open_questions.question: How much targeted removal on the commander does the pilot's actual table run, and when?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The insurance test depends on it, and the log does not record what was aimed at Zada; the Deflecting Swat add is conditional on the answer.

gaps: Forge win rates are not used. The AI does not target Zada to fire her copy trigger, so goblin-storm's runs measure a different deck; Forge is a probe here, not evidence.
No deck_recon.json exists, so no claim here rests on what other Zada lists run.
The goldfish has no blockers and no removal; bodies and kill figures are a ceiling, and protection cannot be priced.
Witch's Mark draw is not modelled by the goldfish, so the card-advantage reading leans on stack 014 (draws 8, discards 4, hand 2 -> 6, net +4), not a rate.
The log has two entries, both losses on this decklist. The cheap-body finding repeats across both, but two games is a small base.
Goblin Burrows and Reliquary Tower are not proposed as cuts: both appear in checker-passed stack 012.

findings.note: Iteration 3. validate-diagnosis OK (16 axes, 2 weak, 3 cut / 4 add, 4 open questions). HEAD is unchanged since round 2 (3a716edd), and a fresh deck-audit shows goldfish_metrics.json and mana_analysis.json still current at sha c8651652…, equal to as_of_decklist_sha256. All 16 axes[].measured.value equal the audit today. The verdict still quotes 4.076, 1.937/2.478 and 0.282, and log causes 001 stalled / 002 raced. There is no saved copy of the round-2 diagnosis: deck-doctor.json is field-identical to the merged diagnosis.json, so it is the round-3 output. 'Nothing else moved' was therefore checked against the figures and fragments my round-2 notes verified, not a byte diff. Every one is present: 'draws 8, discards 4, hand 2 -> 6, net +4' x5, Den of the Bugbear, 43%, 1068, 4.752, the Great Train Heist exclusion, cuts Quest/Throne of Eldraine/Moggcatcher (easy/contested/painful), adds Instigator/Outburst/Swat/Lantern, and the axis verdicts are unchanged.

Iter-1 finding (1) is fixed. cast_turn_histogram['3'] = 1068 and the histogram sums to 10,000, so the figure and the 4.076 mean are both current. 'Partly off rituals' holds: at 3a716edd~1, before the ritual step existed, the T3 bucket was 210 and T2 was 757; the T2 bucket did not move (758), so the ritual effect is in the T3 bucket the reading quotes. goldfish_turn.py:912-913 adds the commander to the ritual step's _wants. Blasphemous Act is in the ramp list only because of its cost clause. Correct.

Iter-1 finding (2) is fixed. I enumerated all 79 entries: Swiftfoot Boots is the only card that can protect Zada. Roaming Throne's Ward {2} covers only itself, and Shinka grants first strike. The quote 'the engine's hub justifies constant protection down plus a held response on the pivot turn' is verbatim from strategy:multiplayer.commander-insurance. The section's conditional half (the decision test, and 'against light-interaction pods, skip the insurance') is still honoured: add_candidates[2] quotes it and open_questions[3] keeps the table's removal open. One real card falls below all three cited bands (5-7, 4-6, 2-4), so a weakness on the count is grounded.

Iter-1 finding (3) is fixed everywhere: axes[5], engine.components[2], lean_into[1], lean_into[2] and gaps[3] all read 'draws 8, discards 4, hand 2 -> 6, net +4'. That matches stack 014's final_state (cards_drawn 8, cards_discarded 4, hand_size 6; checker pass). Witch's Mark appears in goldfish meta.card_advantage.draw_not_modelled. possible_uncounted has the ten cards the reading says it has. Crimson Wisps, Expedite, Fists of Flame and Renegade Tactics each target a creature and draw, per their oracle text.

Iter-1 finding (4) is fixed. Stack 013 (checker pass) final_state: 'put Zada's trigger on the stack first' means Frontline Heroism's trigger resolves first. Order A draws 6 and order B draws 5, and the copies are not cast (707.10). The audit's ignition rates (0.703, and 0.552 by turn 6) match. Daring Discovery is correctly excluded because stack 015 is a checker FAIL.

Iter-1 finding (5) is fixed. Value 5 equals the audit's taplands.value. Den of the Bugbear's oracle text in cards.json is 'If you control two or more other lands, this land enters tapped', which is quoted correctly. That makes it untapped on turns 1-2, so the audit's 'no condition' list misfiles it, and the reading names that disagreement instead of picking a side. The whole strategy:deckbuilding.mana-base section ends 'around eight taplands is comfortable in a slow deck, near zero in an aggressive one'. Applying the aggressive clause to a deck the diagnosis calls go-wide aggro (axes[10]) is in context. The audit's own high of 8 is the slow-deck figure.

Iter-1 finding (6) is fixed: 0.916 is no longer used as a mulligan cost. The 43% is right: 1 - C(88,7)/C(99,7) = 0.574 for 11 copies. I enumerated the 11 nonland body cards at MV<=2 from cards.json and found these 11 and no others. Causes 001 stalled and 002 raced match log_causes.json. The strategy:mulligans.engine-hands quote is verbatim, and the section (mulligan to enabler classes, ship hands that assemble after the field's clock) supports the lean.
0.672 and 0.539 match audit targets[1]. 'Both logged games were in that group' holds: log 001 had 'zero goblins', and all 11 cheap-body cards are Goblins; log 002's only creature was Krenko (MV4).
0.348 and 0.205 match audit targets[2]. 'The ritual change did not move it' checks out: at 3a716edd~1 the same target read 0.347 and 0.204.

Great Train Heist is now excluded because its Treasure enters tapped (its oracle text says 'create a tapped Treasure token'). Ancestors' Aid's Treasure is untapped. The Mana Geyser authored share checks out: goldfish_turn.py:896-898 uses GEYSER_TAPPED_SHARE, and goldfish meta states it as 0.5.

Round-2 over-claim fixed. The entry now reads 'removal on her turns every ignition card except a Frontline Heroism trigger back into a one-for-one, since Frontline Heroism makes a Soldier and copies the spell without her'. That is the scope I asked for. Frontline Heroism's oracle text in cards.json reads 'Whenever you cast a spell that targets only a single creature you control, create a 1/1 red Soldier creature token with haste, then copy that spell'. I enumerated every card in cards.json whose text contains 'copy'. The only non-storm copy engines are Zada and Frontline Heroism. Storm-Kiln Artist's magecraft adds a Treasure, which is mana and not a card, so 'one-for-one' still holds in card terms. Audit targets confirm the 'one route, not the deck' framing: 'Zada online with a cantrip drawn' is commander_gated true; 'Early token maker drawn' and 'Storm payoff plus ritual drawn' are false. The wording 'except a Frontline Heroism trigger' is loose (more exactly, 'unless Frontline Heroism is on the battlefield'), but the following clause makes the meaning plain and the claim is no longer false.

Thirteen counted, minus Impact Tremors, General Kreat and Boggart Shenanigans (oracle text confirms each hits players only), plus Chaos Warp (no role, any permanent) gives 11, as the reading says. The quote is verbatim from strategy:deckbuilding.interaction-suite.

Chaos Warp's oracle text ('target permanent') covers enchantment and land. I enumerated all 79 entries and found no graveyard hate, so the claim that graveyard is the uncovered class holds. The 'cover the classes' quote is in context.
The Snoop and Lackey misreading is fixed. Lackey puts a Goblin from hand onto the battlefield. Snoop casts from the library top and pays the cost.

None of Quest, Throne or Moggcatcher is on a board in any checker-pass stack (001-005, 012, 013, 014, 016). Moggcatcher's only mention in 012 is a checker enumeration note, so orphans_stack [] is correct. The list has one painful entry (Moggcatcher: one of two tutors, priced). Throne's cost now includes the restriction that it cannot pay for colourless spells or activations. Moggcatcher's '4.752 mean mana at turn 5' matches mean_available_mana_by_turn['5']. The Spreading Insurrection cut is withdrawn, which stack 016 (pass, Insurrection into Bombardment) supports.

I ran card-search with identity R. Goblin Instigator ({1}{R} Goblin Rogue, Goblin token), Hordeling Outburst ({1}{R}{R}, three Goblin tokens), Deflecting Swat ({2}{R}, free with a commander) and Soul-Guide Lantern ({1}) are all in identity and Commander-legal, and their oracle text matches each why. Instigator's 57% -> 61% checks out (0.574 -> 0.607). Both fodder adds say they reach the declared target only if added to its any_of, which is honest about the closes. Swat closes protection, and the add keeps the light-pod caveat.

Round-2 caveat addressed. The question now says it 'needs a goldfish model change first' and that 'no flag turns that off', citing goldfish_turn.py:912-913. I re-read those lines: 912 'if commander_turn is None:', 913 '_wants.append(reduced_cost(commander_card, …))'. A grep of goldfish*.py finds no model_/flag key gating it, so the statement is accurate. why_it_matters keeps 1068/10,000 and mean 4.076, both still current, and now says the trade is unpriced until a declared switch exists. That does not over-claim.
